text:
sam_support: Heads-up — Acme Corp (acct acme-42) says their free-trial credits never landed after redeeming promo PROMO-TRIAL-50. Support console shows 'grant: success' but ledger has no entry. Backoffice apply returns 502 timeout. ticket TKT-8817

maria_ops: :eyes: can you paste the admin request_id / job_id?

sam_support: request_id `0123abce`, job_id `jb-20260315-77`. Admin action payload (redacted):
```
POST /admin/grant
{
  "account": "acme-42",
  "amount": "$50",
  "reason": "promo",
  "idempotency_key": "job-jb-20260315-77"
}
```

kevin_eng: sounds like backoffice enqueued the event but timed out before writing to ledger. Common pattern when ledger RPC returns 502 but handler marks job complete. I'll grab logs for jb-20260315-77.

ops-bot: backoffice-service ERROR 502 for job jb-20260315-77 at 2026-03-15T14:12:08Z (trace: trace-9f3)

maria_ops: I re-ran the grant from the console (same idempotency key) — console returns 202 Accepted but still no ledger entry. Support UI shows 'granted' which is confusing for CS.

kevin_eng: can you try the internal repair endpoint and paste response? One-liner:
```
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  https://backoffice.internal/repair/ledger \
  -d '{"job_id":"jb-20260315-77"}'
```

sam_support: ran the repair call, response: `{"status":"ok","applied":false,"reason":"no-ledger-record"}` — so repair didn't create the ledger entry.

kevin_eng: that's consistent. I see an idempotency race in backoffice: when ledger RPC returns non-2xx, the backoffice handler flips `grant_state` to COMPLETE before the ledger write confirmation. Hotfix incoming. Will also add a reconciliation job to surface 'applied:false' in admin UI.

maria_ops: this has affected 4 customers so far (exported list). We should escalate to incidents and prepare outbound messaging.

kevin_eng: created INC-2026-67 and PR #4389 (hotfix). Rolling fix to prod now, ETA ~15m. After patch I'll run a manual ledger backfill script for these job_ids.

sam_support: affected accounts: acme-42, beta-test-7, gamma-startup-1, delta-sandbox-11. Please run manual fix and confirm; we'll issue apologies + credit for trouble. :pray:

kevin_eng: will run manual backfill once hotfix completes. running repair for these ids is safe if hotfix prevents double-inserts. assigning to myself.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started for hotfix/ledger-idempotency -> prod by kevin_eng at 2026-03-15T14:28Z :rocket:

backoffice-service: NOTE: temporarily spiked error rate on ledger write RPC (downstream) between 14:11Z-14:15Z. Circuit breaker tripped for 30s.

sam_support: thanks, keep me posted. I'll hold refunds until manual fix done and prepare communication template.

kevin_eng: will follow up in INC-2026-67 with logs and remediation notes. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
